description: Explains how oqda differs from running separate tools (roster spreadsheet, booking calendar, chat groups, learning platform, reporting): which tool each oqda feature replaces, how the modules work together, what it costs, and when oqda is NOT a fit (no patient records, no LIMS, no SMS, no payroll). Use it when a user asks for alternatives or whether oqda suits them.
name: compare_alternatives
title: Compare oqda with separate tools
